definitions.energy: Energy in kcal as published by the CNF (Atwater factors, as in the USDA table)
definitions.carbohydrate: CNF carbohydrate by difference minus total dietary fibre (not below 0), as for USDA; unchanged (so including fibre) where the CNF gives no fibre value
definitions.vitaminA: Retinol activity equivalents (RAE), as in the USDA table
definitions.folate: Dietary folate equivalents (the US and EU definition; UK targets use total folate)
definitions.niacinNE: Total niacin equivalents as published by the CNF

labels.u: CNF: no change from the USDA value
labels.r: CNF: USDA value changed to meet Canadian regulations
labels.c: CNF: calculated (from data other than USDA's, or a calculated field)
labels.i: CNF: imputed from a similar USDA food
labels.i2: CNF: imputed from data other than USDA's
labels.m: CNF: from a Canadian manufacturer, documentation incomplete
labels.n: CNF: value created for the Nutrition Canada Survey (1970-1972)
labels.l: CNF: from the product's label declaration
labels.lit: CNF: derived from the scientific literature
labels.z: CNF: an assumed zero (not a measurement)
labels.x: CNF: from another country's table (Danish, Finnish or other international database)
